title: Term Bonus on Escrowed Entrance Fee Agreement Deposits
content:
For the escrowed deposit of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** cancelled before occupancy by the resident, a term bonus is added to the escrow rate for the days the deposit was held, counted from the day the deposit was posted to the cancellation date: 90 or more days add 0.40 percentage points, 60 to 89 days add 0.20 percentage points, and fewer than 60 days add nothing; the escrow rate and the term bonus are added together before they are applied.

The posting day is the posting date of the deposit payment on the agreement's ledger; the cancellation date is the termination date recorded on the cancelled agreement. The days are calendar days between the two.

## Bonus ladder

| Days the deposit was held | Term bonus |
|---|---|
| 90 or more | 0.40 percentage points |
| 60 to 89 | 0.20 percentage points |
| Fewer than 60 | None |

## Boundaries

| Days held | Bonus |
|---|---|
| 90 | 0.40 |
| 89 | 0.20 |
| 60 | 0.20 |
| 59 | 0 |

## Hypothetical dates (deposit posted 1 March)

| Cancellation date | Days held | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| 30 May | 90 | 0.40 |
| 29 May | 89 | 0.20 |
| 30 April | 60 | 0.20 |
| 29 April | 59 | 0 |

With a hypothetical escrow rate of 1.55 percent and 90 days held, the rate applied is 1.95 percent a year: the two are added before they act on the deposit.
